name: The Rage of Mert
summary:
A rage game themed around Moarf23, as featured on twitch.tv/moarf23

After Evilmoarf23 teamed up with the devious Trent, the devious duo steal Lomster straight from behind the back of Moarf23, Mert has no choice but to journey, climb, race and jump up the many levels, seamlessly integrated and combined into a challenging rage game! Can he meet all of his awesome mods and collect their individual hats before beating up EvilMoarf and reclaiming his lomster at the top!?
